coverage.authoredAnalysis: Visually read cover: Programa de acción política, Jaén Merece Más, 23J / July 2023 general election. Primary domain and page 13 Congress/Senate language establish provincial scope.

Full contents: rationale, territorial model, integral fund, employment/EU grants, agriculture, health, infrastructure, university, culture and sport. Index names Andalucía fund but body España; jurisdiction discrepancy retained.

Provincial constructive organisation and work/constancy rather than closed promises; legislature representation and constitutional/EU convergence. Party noncompliance claims are attributed background.
Cross-ideology provincial commitment; municipal results and notarial agreements as background. Electoral-usefulness claims are not quiz advice.
Completes usefulness rationale; constitutional solidarity, investment and convergence. No precise national household tax/benefit stance.
Youth emigration/opportunities, all 97 municipalities and equal treatment. Broad priorities do not establish every employment policy.
Historical debt and reference to CES/professional/neighbour/agricultural studies; mobilisation rhetoric rather than new quantified proposal.
Explicit subscription to external España Vaciada model; public stable financing and seven-sector territorial rebalancing. Linked model is a separate unread source.
Completes model rationale and external URL: social/environmental/cultural/economic sustainability. Unseen external proposals cannot be inherited.
Historical infrastructure/industrial decline and attribution of political responsibility. Statistics and causes are source claims, not independently proven.
ERE/Santana account, provincial FECJA integral plan, urgent national territorial/social investment fund bill including Jaén; no household transfer.
Fund/interim State budget criteria; 2023-2027 unemployment-halving/income convergence targets and investment table with execution dates. Targets are not guaranteed outcomes.
Completes investment plan and introduces 178 actions demanded from Congress/Senate of local-to-EU competent administrations; medical/teacher staffing parity and employment diversification.
Measures 3-6: ministry investment, free zone/logistics/reindustrialisation/industry cluster, Jaén/Linares functional areas, restore N-IV eleven-municipality plan.
Measures 7-12: geographically limited Reindus, recovery plans, Santana park, Linares/Jaén dry ports linked to Algeciras/Motril/corridor; ITI audit starts.
Measures 12-18: ITI inquiry/new 2023-2030 frame, POTA priority, industrial anchor, entrepreneur/SME social contributions up to 50% until national convergence, youth incubators/local commerce.
Measures 19-23: exclusive State professional EU grant office for Jaén, REACT/FSE+/youth unemployment >25%, NUTS statistics. Legal descriptions not independently checked.
Measures 23-27: cohesion gap studies, just-transition/FEDER and green-hydrogen/other PERTE at State/regional scope; not provincial PERTE.
Measures 28-38: EIT/Life/digital/urban/Horizon/structural/investment/agricultural/FEAD grants; preserve urban >50,000/consortium eligibility. Source budgets/dates are unverified.
Measures 39-47: SME R&D/EaSI/globalisation/creative grants, national municipal-firefighter framework, olive fraud/traceability and imported-oil standards continued.
Measures 47-52: extra-EU oil equal phytosanitary/labour standards, COI relocation to Jaén, composition/proportion/origin labels, INIA/olive lab/national agrifood research centre.
Measures 52-56: research technologies, agricultural EU project office, cooperatives, young/women succession aid/contribution/tax/shared ownership; no exact bonus amount.
Measures 56-60: women participation/pay, olive R&D/professionalisation, national vocational framework for olive courses, local bottling/sale and university agronomy.
Measures 60-67: dumping defence, renewable grid/biomass/roads, differentiated rural taxation, national depopulation/repopulation law, PAC rights reform, equitable water distribution.

Measures 67-69: Guadalquivir/drought protection; obligatory extra-virgin olive oil in public/public-service catering, school tasting, promotion/geographical indications. Claimed health benefits unverified.

Measures 70-76: olive machinery industry, exclude nonforest-serving cropland from park boundary, wildlife crop-damage compensation, ERHA/alperujo green-hydrogen feasibility, sanitary city/staffing parity.
Measures 76-80: diagnostic/robot parity, 24h night helicopters/Úbeda facilities under AESA requirements, at-least-average health investment. Clinical/safety predictions not certified.
Measures 81-88: rural clinicians/hard-to-fill incentives, stroke radiology, more doctors/nurses/midwives/physiotherapists. Ratios and asserted WHO recommendation are source background.
Measures 88-94: absence coverage/more MIR, consultation/emergency times, home palliative care all localities, emergency georeferencing and physician-staffed mobile ICU.
Measures 94-102: geriatric-unit feasibility, professional incentives, Salud Responde, critical mobile units, disability complex, technology parity, recovery unit and bed ratios.
Measures 103-112: ostomy toilets/single rooms/travel aid, continuous maternity spaces, primary equipment/minor surgery/specialist nurses/rural care/residences, uranium occupational illness claim.
Measures 112-121: complete uranium claim, disability contracted/residential places, staffing/mental health/special-needs children grants, sign interpreters/family/sport/special employment centres.
Measure 122: A32/A81 national and A306/A316 regional motorways, exact routes. Predicted efficiency/safety remain source rationale.
Measures 123-128: 100Mbps symmetric internet, services within 30 minutes, high-capacity road within 30 kilometres; absent annex 1 emergency map; signs/entrance lighting/ring roads.
Measures 129-130: conditional eastern-Andalusia rail Y, commuter/tourist rail, Madrid 2.5h target, stock/fencing/bypass/Las Infantas passing section. Feasibility unverified.
Measures 130-132: goods sidings/faster Cádiz-Granada, retain Linares-Baeza node, central Mediterranean corridor, electricity transmission/distribution/evacuation.
Measures 132-139: park grid/telecom reliability, 5G/EV pilots, lighting/climate efficiency aid, Villacarrillo stratoport/Cetedex/technology. Jobs forecasts unverified.
Measure 139 examples: other Andalusian investments and projected jobs; source comparison not independent findings.
Completes Cádiz/Almería/Jaén investment comparison; measure 140 Ciudad de la Justicia. Do not infer national measures from regional grievance.
Measures 141-146: stable needs-based UJA funding, repeal named June 2021 Andalusian funding basis (unverified legal label), olive chair/foundation/campus/agronomy.
Measures 147-155: technology/research/green degrees, innovation observatory, FP/talent/biomedicine/law-politics-criminology, heritage rescue starts.
Measures 155-162: heritage budget/BIC access, Creative Europe/archaeology/olive heritage, rehabilitation against gentrification/public offices, young families/private-owner repairs.
Measures 163-169: historic-area SME aid, arts/music training, cathedral UNESCO bid/archive premises, grassroots sport/facilities agreements.

Measures 170-177: sporting city/funicular/tourist rail/ferrata/bike/climbing/walkways, greenways/fire/desertification/circular economy, return/repopulate youth aid; repeated Creative Europe and Ariza bridge.
Visually read final page: completes bridge relocation/castles tourist routes, logo/contact. No referenced annex 1 map in this 45-page original.
